# Python examples

Run the package's first-install steps before using an example. See the repository [example guide](https://github.com/jabdori/maxt/blob/main/docs/examples.md). Public reads run normally; credentialed reads require a read-enabled account; request-only examples do not submit financial writes.

## Run the first public read

After installing the package, run:

```text
python -m maxt.examples.binance_public_ticker
```

| Task | Safety | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read public market data | public read | [binance_public_ticker.py](binance_public_ticker.py) |
| Read candles and paged history | public or credentialed read | [candles_history.py](candles_history.py) |
| Receive public and account streams | public read or credentialed read | [streams.py](streams.py) |
| Read balances, rules, and asset configuration | credentialed read | [account_and_safety.py](account_and_safety.py) |
| Inspect and validate order workflows safely | request only or credentialed read | [account_and_safety.py](account_and_safety.py) |
| Inspect transfers and wallet configuration | credentialed read or request only | [account_and_safety.py](account_and_safety.py) |
| Read funding, positions, and margin | public or credentialed read | [derivatives.py](derivatives.py) |
| Use Binance Spot, USD-M, and wallet APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [binance_provider.py](binance_provider.py) |
| Use Upbit region and provider-specific APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [upbit_provider.py](upbit_provider.py) |
| Use Bithumb market, KRW, and TWAP APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [bithumb_provider.py](bithumb_provider.py) |
| Use Hyperliquid market and address-scoped Info APIs | public or address-scoped read | [hyperliquid_provider.py](hyperliquid_provider.py) |
